title: Dow Jones Futures: Trump Says Iran Deal 'Signed' Sunday; SpaceX's Next Test
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：特朗普称伊朗协议周日“签署”； SpaceX 的下一次测试
summary: President Trump says an Iran deal will "get signed" Sunday. The stock market still must do this. What's next for SpaceX?
summary_zh: 特朗普总统表示，伊朗协议将于周日“签署”。股市仍然必须这样做。 SpaceX 的下一步是什么？

title: SpaceX Strikes Rare Deal to Pay $0 to Bankers for IPO Greenshoe
title_zh: SpaceX达成罕见协议，向银行家支付0美元以进行首次公开​​募股绿鞋
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX, which had already negotiated to pay razor-thin fees on its record initial public offering, somehow managed to get an even better deal out of its investment bankers.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 已经在其创纪录的首次公开募股中协商支付极低的费用，不知何故设法从其投资银行家那里获得了更好的交易。

title: Times Square’s New Year’s Eve Ball Joins SpaceX Takeover of NYC
title_zh: 时代广场的除夕舞会加入 SpaceX 收购纽约市的行列
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Even the iconic New Year’s Eve ball is getting involved in the SpaceX IPO celebrations.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——就连标志性的除夕舞会也参与了 SpaceX 的 IPO 庆祝活动。

title: Accounting Firm Crowe to Sell Stake to KKR in Nearly $3 Billion Deal
title_zh: Crowe 会计师事务所将以近 30 亿美元的交易向 KKR 出售股份
summary: The private-equity giant and co-investors would take a majority interest in a firm long resistant to outside ownership.
summary_zh: 这家私募股权巨头和联合投资者将获得一家长期抵制外部所有权的公司的多数股权。

title: Apollo & Blackstone Inc. (BX) Seal $35B Anthropic AI Deal
title_zh: Apollo & Blackstone Inc. (BX) 达成 35B 美元人类人工智能交易
summary: Blackstone Inc. (NYSE:BX) is a deep value stock to invest in now. On June 6, 2026, Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) and Blackstone (NYSE:BX) finalized a $35 billion financing package for Anthropic, according to Bloomberg.
summary_zh: Blackstone Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）是目前值得投资的深度价值股票。据彭博社报道，2026 年 6 月 6 日，阿波罗全球管理公司 (NYSE:APO) 和 Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 敲定了 Anthropic 的 350 亿美元融资方案。
